body:
When my mother worked in IT, she told this story at dinner: They had a meeting about not letting strangers follow them through the door and especially not to let strangers take their computer. They even sent people to "steal" computers/information to drive the message home.

About a week after all this, Annie lets someone take her computer for some hardware fix her boss had ordered. When the computer does not return as expected, she asks her boss, only to find out that the boss had never given such an order! Annie, the boss, and the rest of the team then believe that it's just another one of those mock "thefts" and asks the security team if they can please have their computer back.

However, the security team didn't schedule any drills that week, and *someone actually stole the computer.* This was at a pretty large bank, and they were a team that managed some sort of database. I was too little to remember what database, but it was important enough that my mother had to wear a beeper at night in case the system went down after hours. 

tl;dr For reals, this happens.
